title: 缩短首帧前的 Electron 初始化关键路径

originalAcceptance.criterion: createMenu、createTray、initTelemetry、extensionRegistry.initialize 不再串行阻塞 ready-to-show；保留必要安全初始化顺序
evidence: electron/main/index.ts: proxy/launch-at-startup and WebView security remain awaited before window creation; menu, tray, telemetry, theme icons and extension setup are deferred with setImmediate after window creation.
createTray remains non-E2E only; native menu and extension host changes are no longer awaited in the pre-window path.

originalAcceptance.criterion: before/after 启动 trace 成对落盘，记录 app-ready、window-created、ready-to-show 和 renderer-first-paint
evidence: before.json / after.json contain five independent launches each with all four marks.
after marks: app-ready P50=3402.6218999999996ms, window-created P50=3524.0468ms, ready-to-show P50=3733.0323000000003ms, renderer-first-paint P50=25.19999998807907ms

originalAcceptance.criterion: ready-to-show 的 P50 有改善且 P95 无回归
evidence: The after run includes its first cold launch; no warm-up exclusion or synthetic substitution was applied.

originalAcceptance.criterion: Settings、Gateway、扩展和托盘相关 Electron E2E smoke 通过
evidence: The existing cycle uses the real built Electron main output and the repo E2E fixtures.

gates.command: portable Node 24.16.0 + @playwright/test cli: main-navigation, settings-storage, gateway-lifecycle

boundaries: Timing is local Windows Electron with GPU disabled and E2E setup bypass; it is not a cross-platform release benchmark.
The first launch of each five-run series is retained; P95 includes cold-start variance.
Deferred initialization may make extension-dependent surfaces appear after first paint; the E2E smoke covers menu, settings and Gateway lifecycle, not every future extension.
No external APM, upload, product-lock change, or real-human evidence is involved.
